documents.name: SpotiFLAC Mobile
documents.subtitle: FLAC Downloader for iOS
documents.description: SpotiFLAC Mobile is an open-source Spotify track and playlist metadata downloader and FLAC converter for iOS and Android. Search and download high-quality FLAC and MP3 audio with complete ID3 metadata, embedded album artwork, and synchronized lyrics directly on your device.

documents.name: uYouEnhanced
documents.subtitle: uYouPlus with even more features!
documents.description: uYou is the best tweak for the YouTube app. uYouEnhanced is a modified version of qnblackcat's uYouPlus & MiRO92's uYou with even more features. Additional features include skipping sponsorships in videos, more PiP options, unlocking higher resolutions, disabling overlays, removing upsell alerts, dimming the UI, enabling the miniplayer, preventing notch issues, configuring A/B settings, and adding a timestamp button.

documents.name: YouTubePlus
documents.subtitle: Lightweight YouTube tweak with no ads and PiP
documents.shortDescription: Lightweight YouTube tweak with no ads and PiP
documents.description: YouTubePlus (formerly YTLite) is a lightweight enhancer for YouTube developed by Dayanch96. It provides complete ad blocking, background playback, offline video and audio downloads, Picture-in-Picture (PiP), SponsorBlock integration, gesture controls, and customizable interface settings.

documents.name: YouPro
documents.subtitle: Feature-rich YouTube tweak by alibusut
documents.description: YouPro is an advanced YouTube modification tweak developed by alibusut. It features background playback, ad-free streaming, inline download capabilities, OLED true dark theme, SponsorBlock, and enhanced media playback controls.

documents.name: YTKillerPlus
documents.subtitle: Advanced YouTube tweak with extensive controls
documents.shortDescription: Advanced YouTube tweak with extensive controls
documents.description: YTKillerPlus is an advanced feature-packed YouTube tweak by iKarwan. It offers comprehensive ad blocking, background playback, high-speed downloads, PiP, custom player actions, OLED dark theme, and granular privacy controls.

documents.name: YTKACE
documents.subtitle: YTKACE
documents.description: YTKACE is a free, open-source YouTube enhancer and downloader for iOS. No ads, background playback, video and audio downloads, SponsorBlock, Picture in Picture, player gestures and deep interface customization.

documents.name: uPro Plus
documents.subtitle: YouTube 21.37.4 extra-tweaks build (YouMod + player stack)
documents.description: uPro Plus is OmniSource's featured YouTube 21.37.4 extra-tweaks IPA. It is the YouProEXTRA YouMod 2.0.0 line on YouTube 21.37.4 with the extra player stack that release publishes: YouPip (Picture-in-Picture), YouQuality and YouChooseQuality, YTHoldForSpeed, YouGetCaption, YTABConfig, YTNativeShare, YTweaks, Return YouTube Dislike, DontEatMyContent, Gonerino, VolumeBoostYT and PleaseDontStopTheMusic. 120 Hz display refresh is used when the device supports it. Native 4K is available on A16+ devices; YTUHD is not bundled on this YouTube version. Requires iOS 17.0+. Shares com.google.ios.youtube with the other YouTube mods: install one at a time. YTLite, YTKACE and YouMod are competing main tweaks; stacking all three in one IPA is unstable, so this listing follows the extra-tweaks YouMod 21.37.4 release.

documents.name: MaxTube
documents.subtitle: YTPlus with ten extra tweaks
documents.description: MaxTube (formerly YTPlusM) is Mark02-2012's fork of YTPlus/YTLite, the enhancer for the YouTube app on iOS. On top of the YTPlus feature set — video/audio/thumbnail downloads, SponsorBlock, PiP, YTUHD, YouQuality, Return YouTube Dislike, YTABConfig, DontEatMyContent and over 100 configurable options without a subscription — MaxTube integrates ten extra tweaks: YTweaks, Gonerino, YouSpeed, YTLowContrastMode, VolumeBoostYT, YouGetCaption, YTPlaybackFix, YouChooseQuality, YouShare and PleaseDontStopTheMusic. Settings live inside YouTube under Settings.

documents.name: YTMusicUltimate
documents.subtitle: Lightweight YouTube Music tweak
documents.description: YTMusicUltimate is a lightweight enhancer for YouTube Music by Dayanch96. It unlocks background audio playback, removes in-app advertisements, enables premium audio streaming quality, and provides customizable player themes.

documents.name: MaxMusic
documents.subtitle: YTMusicUltimate with extra tweaks
documents.description: MaxMusic (formerly YTMUltimate+) is Mark02-2012's fork of Dayanch96's YTMusicUltimate for the YouTube Music app on iOS. It keeps everything YTMusicUltimate provides — no ads, background playback, download manager, audio quality selection — and adds Return YouTube Music Dislike, YouMusicPiP, YTMABConfig and VolumeBoostYT, plus fixed in-app downloads on newer YouTube Music versions. Settings live inside YouTube Music under Settings.

documents.name: UTM
documents.subtitle: Virtual machines for iOS
documents.description:
Run real operating systems on your iPhone or iPad. UTM is an open-source (Apache-2.0) virtualization and emulation platform built on QEMU, capable of running Windows, Linux, classic Mac OS and dozens of other systems alongside your apps.

Highlights:
- QEMU v10.0.2 backend with support for dozens of CPU architectures (x86_64, ARM64, RISC-V, PowerPC and more)
- Improved machine wizard with well-tested configurations such as Windows, Ubuntu, RISC-V64 Ubuntu, classic Mac OS 8.x/9.x and Windows 95/98
- Custom keyboard shortcuts (e.g. Ctrl+Alt+Del) sent directly to the VM from the Keyboard menu
- App Intents automation with the Shortcuts app
- Liquid Glass design on iOS 26
- Import and export .utm virtual machine bundles via the Files app
- No jailbreak required; highest performance with JIT workarounds on supported iOS versions

documents.name: iNKillerPlus
documents.subtitle: Instagram with downloads, ghost mode and no ads
documents.shortDescription: Instagram with downloads, ghost mode and no ads
documents.description: iNKillerPlus is a modified Instagram by iKarwan. Download posts, reels, stories and DM media, save profile pictures, block promoted posts and ads, toggle seen/unseen for stories and DMs, ghost typing, hide tabs, copy comments and bios, confirmation prompts before liking or calling, and a profile analyzer. iPadOS supported.

documents.name: TTKillerPlus
documents.subtitle: TikTok with downloads, no ads and region switch
documents.shortDescription: TikTok with downloads, no ads and region switch
documents.description: TTKillerPlus is a modified TikTok by iKarwan. Download videos from the feed, stories and Explore, save photos and profile avatars, merge post photos with their music, block promoted posts and ads, toggle seen/unseen, hide tabs, browse the feed of a specific country, show country flags and post dates, and auto-like in live streams. iPadOS supported.

documents.name: Winston
documents.subtitle: Open-source Reddit client
documents.description: Winston is a beautiful open-source Reddit client for iOS built in SwiftUI, with themes, gestures, an inline media viewer and a fast comment thread reader. Because Reddit charges for API access, Winston asks you to create your own free Reddit API credentials on first launch.

documents.name: iTorrent
documents.subtitle: Torrent client with a built-in player
documents.shortDescription: Torrent client with a built-in player
documents.description: iTorrent is a fully featured open-source torrent client for iOS. It keeps downloading in the background, integrates with the Files app, supports magnet links, sequential download and per-file selection, and ships a built-in VLC-based player with Picture in Picture, audio and subtitle tracks and playback speed control.

documents.name: StikDebug
documents.subtitle: On-device JIT enabler and debugger
documents.description: StikDebug attaches a debugger to your sideloaded apps directly on device, which enables JIT for emulators and other apps that need it. It uses a pairing file and an on-device VPN loop, so no computer is required after the initial setup. Requires iOS 17.4 or newer.

documents.name: BHTwitter
documents.subtitle: X (Twitter) with no ads, downloads and the chronological timeline
documents.shortDescription: X (Twitter) with no ads, downloads and the chronological timeline
documents.description: BHTwitter is a long-running tweak for X (formerly Twitter), published as a ready-to-sideload IPA. It hides promoted posts and ads, restores the chronological timeline as the default, and lets you download videos, GIFs and images straight from a post. It also adds Face ID / Touch ID app lock, custom fonts, undo posting, inline translation, direct saving of profile pictures and headers, confirmation prompts for likes and reposts, and switches for hiding the tabs and UI elements you never use.

documents.name: LiveContainer
documents.subtitle: Run iOS apps without actually installing them
documents.shortDescription: Run iOS apps without actually installing them
documents.description: LiveContainer runs other iOS apps inside itself instead of installing them, so a single app slot on your certificate can host many sideloaded apps and you stop burning through the 3-app limit. When JIT is available it bypasses codesigning entirely; otherwise guest apps are signed with the same certificate as LiveContainer. It supports multiple data containers per app, tweak injection, adding guest apps to the Home Screen, and multitasking windows on iPadOS 16 and later.

documents.name: Feather
documents.subtitle: On-device app manager, signer and installer
documents.shortDescription: On-device app manager, signer and installer
documents.description: Feather is a free on-device iOS and iPadOS application manager built with UIKit. Import your own developer or enterprise certificate to sign and install IPAs directly from the device, add AltStore-compatible repositories to browse and update apps, keep a library of signed and imported apps, and tweak bundle identifiers, display names, icons and injected dylibs per app - no computer or AltServer required.

documents.name: SideStore
documents.subtitle: AltStore fork that refreshes apps without a computer
documents.shortDescription: AltStore fork that refreshes apps without a computer
documents.description: SideStore is a fork of AltStore that signs and refreshes sideloaded apps directly on the device. After a one-time pairing-file setup it renews 7-day certificates in the background using your own Apple ID and an anisette server, so apps stop expiring while you are away from a computer. It installs apps from any AltStore-compatible source, keeps them updated, and can back up and restore app data.

documents.name: Aidoku
documents.subtitle: Free and open-source manga reader
documents.description: Aidoku is a free and open-source manga reader for iOS and iPadOS with no ads and no tracking. Content comes from community-maintained source lists that you add yourself, so nothing is bundled with the app. It downloads chapters for offline reading, syncs library, history and settings through iCloud, supports external trackers, and offers paged, vertical and continuous reading modes with customisable layouts.

documents.name: Provenance
documents.subtitle: Multi-system retro game emulator
documents.description: Provenance is a multi-emulator front-end covering Atari, Bandai, NEC, Nintendo, Sega, SNK and Sony systems from a single library. It handles save states, cheats, MFi and native game controllers, Metal-based scaling filters, per-core settings, and imports your own ROMs and BIOS files through the Files app, iCloud or its built-in web uploader.

documents.name: Delta
documents.subtitle: All-in-one retro emulator by Riley Testut
documents.shortDescription: All-in-one retro emulator by Riley Testut
documents.description: Delta is an all-in-one classic video game emulator for non-jailbroken iOS devices, developed by Riley Testut as the spiritual successor to GBA4iOS. It emulates the Nintendo systems (Game Boy Color, Game Boy Advance, Nintendo DS, Nintendo 64, SNES, NES) plus Sega Genesis and Game Gear, with save states and cheats, controller and Nintendo DS skin support, iCloud sync of saves, and full MFi/Bluetooth controller support.

documents.name: PPSSPP
documents.subtitle: Fast PlayStation Portable (PSP) emulator
documents.description: PPSSPP is a fast and portable PlayStation Portable (PSP) emulator developed by Henrik Rydgård. It runs PSP games at up to double native resolution with anisotropic filtering and shader effects, supports save states anywhere, hardware controllers, and needs no BIOS file thanks to its high-level emulation approach.

documents.name: Yattee
documents.subtitle: Privacy-oriented native video player
documents.description: Yattee is a privacy-oriented, fully native video player for iPhone, iPad and Apple TV. It plays from user-configured Invidious or Piped backends and local video libraries, with SponsorBlock, chapters, background audio, Picture in Picture, subscriptions, and full keyboard and remote control support.

documents.name: Streamyfin
documents.subtitle: Open-source Jellyfin client for iOS
documents.description: Streamyfin is an open-source Jellyfin client for iPhone and iPad built with Expo and React Native. Stream your Jellyfin server's library with offline downloads, background audio, Picture in Picture, Chromecast, intro skipping, live TV, and an optional MPV-based player — no server plugins required.

documents.name: Spotube
documents.subtitle: Open-source Spotify music client
documents.description: Spotube is an open-source, cross-platform music streaming client that combines Spotify's metadata — your playlists, albums, liked songs and recommendations — with community audio sources, so you can play your whole Spotify library without ads or telemetry. Includes lyrics and a plugin system for extending playback sources.

documents.name: Jellify
documents.subtitle: Native Jellyfin music player for iOS
documents.shortDescription: Native Jellyfin music player for iOS
documents.description: Jellify is a free and open-source music player for Jellyfin, built with React Native. Browse and stream your Jellyfin music libraries on iPhone and iPad with a native interface, fast search, playlists, favorites and now-playing controls — available on the App Store and as sideload builds.

documents.name: Zeus
documents.subtitle: Self-custodial Bitcoin and Lightning wallet
documents.description: Zeus is a free and open-source, self-custodial Bitcoin and Lightning wallet for iPhone and iPad. Connect the app to your own node (LND, Core Lightning, c-lightning-REST, BTCPay Server or Lightning Terminal) or use the built-in Olympus LNDHub for a quick start, with contacts, Nostr Wallet Connect, LNURL, point-of-sale and full on-chain and Lightning payment support.

documents.name: BlueWallet
documents.subtitle: Open-source Bitcoin wallet for iOS
documents.description: BlueWallet is a free and open-source Bitcoin wallet focused on simplicity and power. Create standard on-chain wallets, watch-only wallets with full PSBT and hardware-wallet support, and Lightning wallets backed by the built-in LNDHUB or your own node — with fee control, multisig (Vault) and Tor connectivity.

documents.name: Voyager
documents.subtitle: Beautiful open-source client for Lemmy
documents.description: Voyager is a free and open-source client for Lemmy and PieFed with an iOS-native feel — swipe gestures, haptics, infinite scroll, rich markdown support, multi-account switching and deep theming. The same project powers the official Voyager App Store release; this feed tracks the developer's own GitHub build.

documents.name: Saber
documents.subtitle: Open-source handwritten notes
documents.description: Saber is a free and open-source handwritten notes app built with Flutter. Write with your finger or Apple Pencil as if on paper, organize notes into folders, keep them private with encryption, and sync across devices using its optional Nextcloud-based sync — no vendor lock-in.

documents.name: Anx Reader
documents.subtitle: Open-source e-book reader with AI
documents.description: Anx Reader is a free and open-source e-book reader for iPhone and iPad. Read EPUB, MOBI and other formats with a polished reader engine, AI-powered summaries and translations (bring your own key), text-to-speech, highlights and notes, reading statistics, and WebDAV sync across devices.

documents.name: Apollo
documents.subtitle: The beloved Reddit client, continued by Apollo-Reborn
documents.shortDescription: The beloved Reddit client, continued by Apollo-Reborn
documents.description: Apollo was the beloved, award-winning Reddit client for iPhone and iPad known for its beautiful native interface, powerful gestures, jump-to-comments, inline media reading and fanatic attention to detail. After Reddit's API changes ended the original app, the Apollo-Reborn project now publishes official continuation builds that work against Reddit's public API — keeping the classic Apollo experience alive.

documents.name: DolphiniOS
documents.subtitle: GameCube and Wii emulator for iOS
documents.shortDescription: GameCube and Wii emulator for iOS
documents.description: DolphiniOS is the Dolphin GameCube and Wii emulator ported to iOS by OatmealDome, requiring no jailbreak. It runs the full Dolphin core with Metal rendering via MoltenVK, supports controllers, save states and high-resolution rendering, and plays your legally dumped GameCube and Wii games.

documents.name: iSH
documents.subtitle: Linux shell on iOS via x86 emulation
documents.shortDescription: Linux shell on iOS via x86 emulation
documents.description: iSH is an open-source project that runs a Linux shell environment on iOS using a user-mode x86 emulator. It provides Alpine Linux with the APK package manager, so you can install and run familiar command-line tools — ssh, git, python, vim and more — entirely on your iPhone or iPad, no jailbreak required.

documents.name: qBitControl
documents.subtitle: qBittorrent remote control for iOS
documents.description: qBitControl is a native qBittorrent remote control app for iPhone and iPad. Manage your torrents from anywhere: add, pause, resume and recheck torrents, browse files and set priorities, configure speed and seeding limits, use custom HTTP headers and self-signed certificates, and track RSS feeds — all against your own qBittorrent WebUI.

documents.name: qBitConnect
documents.subtitle: Modern qBittorrent remote client
documents.description: qBitConnect is a modern, open-source qBittorrent remote client for iPhone and iPad built with Flutter. Connect to your qBittorrent WebUI to add, manage and monitor torrents with a clean, adaptive interface, push notifications for finished downloads, RSS support and quick actions.

documents.name: VCMI
documents.subtitle: Open-source Heroes of Might & Magic III engine
documents.shortDescription: Open-source Heroes of Might & Magic III engine
documents.description: VCMI is an open-source engine that re-implements Heroes of Might and Magic III so the classic turn-based strategy game runs on modern hardware — with widescreen and high-resolution support, extensive modding (including the popular HotA and Era mods), stabilized multiplayer and quality-of-life improvements over the original. Requires a copy of the original game's data files.

documents.name: MAME4iOS
documents.subtitle: Multi-arcade machine emulator for iOS
documents.description: MAME4iOS brings the Multiple Arcade Machine Emulator to iPhone, iPad and Apple TV, running thousands of classic arcade games from the 70s, 80s, 90s and beyond. Includes an on-screen joystick, full MFi controller support, netplay, and a menu to organize your legally dumped ROM sets.

documents.name: qBitController
documents.subtitle: Cross-platform qBittorrent remote (Kotlin)
documents.description: qBitController is a free and open-source qBittorrent remote client built with Kotlin Multiplatform and Compose. Control your qBittorrent WebUI from iPhone or iPad: add torrents by URL or file, pause/resume and recheck, browse file lists and set priorities, and manage categories and tags with a clean Material-style interface.

documents.name: Mini vMac
documents.subtitle: Early Macintosh emulator for iOS
documents.description: Mini vMac for iOS emulates the earliest Apple Macintosh computers (128K, 512K, Plus and II), letting you run classic System 1 through System 7 software on modern devices. Load your own ROM and disk images, with support for external keyboards, mice and multiple emulated machine variants.

documents.name: StikNES
documents.subtitle: NES/Famicom emulator for modern iOS
documents.description: StikNES is a Nintendo Entertainment System / Famicom emulator for iPhone and iPad from the StikEMU team, built for modern iOS with Metal-accelerated rendering, MFi and keyboard controller support, save states and a focus on accuracy and low latency. Load your own legally dumped ROMs.

documents.name: TwitchAdBlock
documents.subtitle: Ad blocker for the Twitch app on iOS
documents.shortDescription: Ad blocker for the Twitch app on iOS
documents.description: TwitchAdBlock is an open-source tweak for the native Twitch iOS app that blocks advert break requests at the network layer, so streams play without ads and without the purple loading screen. This fork by gunnerkidBT keeps the tweak working on the latest Twitch releases (29.x-30.x) and modern iOS versions, and publishes ready-to-sideload IPAs built from the official tweak source.

documents.name: NeoFreeBird
documents.subtitle: Modified Twitter with QoL fixes and reverts
documents.shortDescription: Modified Twitter with QoL fixes and reverts
documents.description: NeoFreeBird is a modified build of the official Twitter app that reverts unpopular rebranding and interface changes, restores classic features, and bundles quality-of-life modifications including BHTwitter options — built and published automatically from the project's GitHub releases. Shares com.atebits.Tweetie2 with the App Store Twitter/X app and BHTwitter: install one at a time.

documents.name: Conduit
documents.subtitle: Native client for Open WebUI & Ollama
documents.shortDescription: Native client for Open WebUI & Ollama
documents.description: Conduit is a native, open-source iOS and Android client for Open WebUI, direct OpenAI-compatible endpoints, Ollama and Hermes. Chat with your own self-hosted local models or API-backed ones with a polished SwiftUI interface — conversations stay in sync, code blocks render properly, and your data never touches a third-party server.

documents.name: Fladder
documents.subtitle: Cross-platform Jellyfin frontend
documents.description: Fladder is a free and open-source Jellyfin frontend built on Flutter, giving you a beautiful Netflix-style interface over your own media library on iPhone and iPad. Direct play and transcode support, offline viewing with sync, multi-server switching, and full library management — no server plugins required.

documents.name: AnymeX
documents.subtitle: Anime, manga, novels & tracking, open source
documents.shortDescription: Anime, manga, novels & tracking, open source
documents.description: AnymeX is an open-source, cross-platform app for streaming anime and reading manga, manhwa, light and web novels, with deep integration for tracking services (AniList, MyAnimeList, Simkl and Kitsu). Extensions keep sources working, and your library, progress and statistics stay in sync across services.

documents.name: Sora
documents.subtitle: Modular media streaming app for iOS
documents.shortDescription: Modular media streaming app for iOS
documents.description: Sora is a modular, open-source media player for iPhone, iPad and Mac that streams movies and shows from community-maintained modules, with AniList sync, watching collections, watch-next recommendations, bookmarks and a fast native SwiftUI interface. The current build line is distributed as Sulfur.

documents.name: RainTweak
documents.subtitle: Discord client mod with themes and QoL fixes
documents.shortDescription: Discord client mod with themes and QoL fixes
documents.description: RainTweak injects Rain - the community Discord client mod - into the official Discord iOS app, adding themes, appearance options and quality-of-life fixes on top of a current Discord build. The ready-to-sideload IPA is built and published by the RainTweak project itself, so the download comes straight from the developer's own releases.

documents.name: Infuse Plus
documents.subtitle: Enhancer tweak for the Infuse video player
documents.shortDescription: Enhancer tweak for the Infuse video player
documents.description: Infuse Plus (by Dayanch96) enhances the Infuse video player with extra appearance options, app icon choices and playback quality-of-life improvements on top of the stock Infuse 8 app. The build follows the latest Infuse release.

documents.name: Glow
documents.subtitle: Clean, powerful Facebook tweak by dayanch96
documents.shortDescription: Clean, powerful Facebook tweak by dayanch96
documents.description: Glow is a simple, clean and powerful tweak for Facebook by Dayanch96: it removes ads and sponsored content, adds video downloads, unlocks media quality options and hides unwanted UI elements on top of the official Facebook app.

documents.name: Swiftgram
documents.subtitle: Supercharged open-source Telegram fork
documents.description: Swiftgram is a supercharged, open-source Telegram fork: ghost mode, hide read receipts and online status, save protected media, unlimited account switching and deep interface customization. The project officially ships through the App Store and TestFlight; this entry serves a ready-to-sideload IPA build (Swiftgram base with the MxGram tweak).

documents.name: Telegram MxGram
documents.subtitle: Official Telegram with the MxGram tweak
documents.shortDescription: Official Telegram with the MxGram tweak
documents.description: MxGram injects the MxGram tweak into the official Telegram app: ghost mode with per-user exceptions, anti-revoke and anti-edit, saving of protected media, fake GPS, download boost and more, localized in 10 languages.

documents.name: iQFace
documents.subtitle: Facebook tweak build by 7MD
documents.description: iQFace is a tweaked Facebook build with the iQFace tweak by 7MD, one of the Facebook modifications distributed ready-to-sideload through the IPA Vault source. Feature set is defined by the iQFace tweak.

documents.name: RyukGram
documents.subtitle: Instagram tweak for power users by faroukbmiled
documents.shortDescription: Instagram tweak for power users by faroukbmiled
documents.description: RyukGram - the Instagram tweak for iOS power users by faroukbmiled - adds media saving, ghost mode, feed cleaning, download buttons and deep customization on top of the official Instagram app.

documents.name: Sparkle
documents.subtitle: Bring the spark back to Instagram
documents.shortDescription: Bring the spark back to Instagram
documents.description: Sparkle (by efibalogh) brings the spark back to Instagram: downloads for reels and stories, ghost mode, ad hiding, restored classic behaviours and UI customization on top of the official Instagram app.

documents.name: RedditFilter
documents.subtitle: Filter unwanted content from your Reddit feed
documents.shortDescription: Filter unwanted content from your Reddit feed
documents.description: RedditFilter (by level3tjg) filters unwanted content out of your Reddit feed - hide posts by keyword, subreddit, domain, flair or author, natively on top of the official Reddit app. The project publishes a ready-to-sideload IPA with every release.

documents.name: NexaSC
documents.subtitle: SoundCloud Go+ unlock and ad removal (unofficial build)
documents.shortDescription: SoundCloud Go+ unlock and ad removal (unofficial build)
documents.description: NexaSC is a community SoundCloud tweak by cielogic: it unlocks SoundCloud Go+ features, removes ads, adds track downloads and can fetch lyrics automatically (via LRCLIB). The tweak is opened by long-pressing the home icon.

documents.name: Messenger Flow
documents.subtitle: Facebook Messenger tweak by dvntms (unofficial build)
documents.shortDescription: Facebook Messenger tweak by dvntms (unofficial build)
documents.description: Messenger Flow is a tweaked Facebook Messenger build by dvntms, distributed ready-to-sideload through the IPA Vault on a current Messenger base version. The Flow tweak's feature set is defined by its build; no official public documentation exists.

documents.name: MSGPlusX
documents.subtitle: Messenger tweak by Dens0r & lucaspedrosa (unofficial build)
documents.shortDescription: Messenger tweak by Dens0r & lucaspedrosa (unofficial build)
documents.description: MSGPlusX is a tweaked Facebook Messenger build (MessengerPlus lineage by Dens0r and lucaspedrosa), distributed ready-to-sideload through the IPA Vault on a current Messenger base version. The tweak's feature set is defined by its build; no official public documentation exists.

documents.name: ThreadSaver
documents.subtitle: Threads enhancement tweak (unofficial build)
documents.description: ThreadSaver (by swiftleopard) is a tweaked Threads build distributed ready-to-sideload through the IPA Vault on a current Threads base version. The tweak's feature set is defined by its build; no official public documentation exists.

documents.name: iMe MxGram
documents.subtitle: MxGram-tweaked iMe messenger (unofficial build)
documents.description: iMe MxGram is the third-party iMe messenger with the MxGram tweak (by m1ronx1412) injected: ghost mode with per-user exceptions, anti-revoke, saving of protected media and more, on top of the iMe Telegram client.

documents.name: Turrit MxGram
documents.subtitle: MxGram-tweaked Turrit client (unofficial build)
documents.description: Turrit MxGram is the third-party Turrit messenger with the MxGram tweak (by m1ronx1412) injected: ghost mode with per-user exceptions, anti-revoke, saving of protected media and more, on top of the Turrit Telegram client.

documents.name: RyukGram (IG 410)
documents.subtitle: RyukGram built on the Instagram 410 app
documents.shortDescription: RyukGram built on the Instagram 410 app
documents.description: RyukGram (IG 410) is the same enhanced Instagram client ported to the Instagram 410.1.0 app for iOS 15 and later. It carries the full RyukGram feature set — follow-request tracking, read receipts, story-viewer insights, deleted-message logs, device-ID masking, media downloading, custom chat themes and a configurable tab bar — on top of the older Instagram base, which is what you want if the current Instagram builds are unstable on your device or you deliberately stay on an older app version.

documents.name: RyukGram Side by Side
documents.subtitle: RyukGram under its own bundle id, next to Instagram
documents.shortDescription: RyukGram under its own bundle id, next to Instagram
documents.description: RyukGram Side by Side is the RyukGram build packaged under its own bundle identifier, com.ryuk.ryukgram, so it installs alongside the real Instagram app instead of replacing it. Both apps get their own name, icon and login, so you can stay signed into a stock account and a modded one at the same time. This variant ships the no-plugin-loader build.

documents.name: Dopamine
documents.subtitle: Semi-untethered jailbreak for iOS 15 – 26
documents.description: Dopamine is the modern semi-untethered, rootless jailbreak for iOS and iPadOS 15.0 through 26.0.1. It bootstraps a Procursus environment (Sileo and friends) on supported arm64e and arm64 devices, keeps passcode, Touch ID/Face ID and Apple Pay working, and hides its filesystem changes well enough to stay through a userspace reboot. This entry tracks the official Dopamine app the developer publishes on GitHub Releases.

documents.name: Dopamine (RootHide)
documents.subtitle: Dopamine fork that hides the jailbreak from apps
documents.shortDescription: Dopamine fork that hides the jailbreak from apps
documents.description: Dopamine (RootHide) is roothide's hardened Dopamine 2 build for iOS 15.0 through 16.7.x. It runs the jailbreak in a hidden, per-app environment: App Store apps do not see the bootstrap or your tweaks unless you explicitly patch them, and extra work is done to hide jailbreak traces from detection. It keeps the usual Dopamine toolchain — Sileo, rootless tweaks and userspace reboots — under a separate bundle identifier so it can sit next to the stock Dopamine app.

documents.name: Bootstrap
documents.subtitle: RootHide bootstrap for iOS 15 – 17
documents.description: Bootstrap is roothide's semi-jailbreak bootstrap for iOS and iPadOS 15.0 through 17.0 on A8 to A17 Pro and M1/M2 devices. Instead of jailbreaking the whole system it builds a hidden environment that boots Sileo, Zebra and rootless tweaks while App Store apps stay untouched — so banking, streaming and game apps that refuse to run on a jailbroken device keep working. Apps are patched one at a time when you want tweaks inside them, and the whole environment can be removed again.

documents.name: Serotonin
documents.subtitle: Semi-jailbreak for iOS 16.5.1 – 17.0
documents.description: Serotonin is a semi-untethered 'semi-jailbreak' for iOS 16.5.1 through 16.7 RC and iOS 17.0 on arm64e devices. Built on the Fugu15 code base, it gives you tweak injection and a Procursus bootstrap without a full jailbreak: tweaks load into the apps you patch, and the device keeps working normally everywhere else.

documents.name: Taurine
documents.subtitle: Semi-untethered jailbreak for iOS 14
documents.description: Taurine is the Odyssey Team's semi-untethered jailbreak for iOS 14.0 – 14.3 on A9 to A14 devices using the cicuta_virosa and amfid exploits. It installs Sileo and a libhooker-based tweak environment, keeps passcode support, and boots into a userspace jailbreak from the app. Useful for keeping vintage firmwares usable on older iPhones and iPads.

documents.name: Odyssey
documents.subtitle: Semi-untethered jailbreak for iOS 13
documents.description: Odyssey is the Odyssey Team's semi-untethered jailbreak for iOS 13.0 – 13.7 on A9 through A13 devices. It uses the same modern approach as Taurine — libhooker tweak injection, Sileo as the package manager and a userspace jailbreak you re-apply after a reboot — and remains the standard choice for iOS 13 firmwares that unc0ver and checkra1n handle less comfortably.

documents.name: unc0ver
documents.subtitle: Jailbreak for iOS 11 – 14.8.1
documents.description: unc0ver is the long-running semi-untethered jailbreak by pwn20wnd for iOS 11.0 through 14.8.1. Its final 5.2.0 release covers the widest firmware range of the classic jailbreaks, installing Cydia or Sileo depending on the chosen bootstrap, and it stays useful for the 32-bit era iPhones and iPads that are otherwise stuck without a package manager.

documents.name: SameBoy
documents.subtitle: High-accuracy Game Boy and Game Boy Color emulator
documents.shortDescription: High-accuracy Game Boy and Game Boy Color emulator
documents.description: SameBoy is a highly accurate Game Boy and Game Boy Color emulator by LIJI32, ported to iPhone and iPad. It emulates the original hardware closely enough to pass hardware test ROMs, supports Super Game Boy palettes and link-cable emulation between its own instances, ships a built-in debugger, rewinding, save states and cheat support, and lets you import your own ROMs from Files.

documents.name: Gopeed
documents.subtitle: Modern download manager for HTTP, BitTorrent and more
documents.shortDescription: Modern download manager for HTTP, BitTorrent and more
documents.description: Gopeed is a modern, open-source download manager written in Go with a Flutter interface. On iOS it handles HTTP/HTTPS, BitTorrent and magnet links, splits downloads into multiple connections, resumes interrupted transfers, and lets you queue and manage everything with upload and download limits. It is the maintained alternative to iTorrent when you want torrents plus ordinary file downloads in the same app.

documents.name: Manic EMU
documents.subtitle: All-in-one retro game emulator
documents.description: Manic EMU is an all-in-one retro emulator for iPhone and iPad. One app covers NES, SNES, N64, Game Boy and Game Boy Advance, Nintendo DS and 3DS, PlayStation, PSP, Dreamcast, Arcade and more through libretro cores, with a game library that imports your own ROMs, per-core control mapping, cheat support, save states and controller support. The upstream project is AGPL-3.0 and publishes its own signed-for-testing builds.

documents.name: XeniOS
documents.subtitle: Xbox 360 emulation for iPhone and iPad
documents.shortDescription: Xbox 360 emulation for iPhone and iPad
documents.description: XeniOS is an experimental Apple-focused fork of Xenia, the Xbox 360 emulator research project, built for iPhone, iPad and Apple silicon Macs. The iOS build ships as an unsigned IPA and needs recent, powerful hardware: the upstream CMake configuration sets the iOS deployment target to 18.0, and the emulated PowerPC cores plus the Xbox 360 GPU workload only reach playable frame rates on A17 Pro / M-series class chips. It carries the same edge-line core as upstream Xenia and reports game compatibility on xenios.jp. As with every console emulator, you supply your own game files.

documents.name: PikaTorrent
documents.subtitle: BitTorrent client
documents.description: PikaTorrent is a modern cross-platform BitTorrent client for iOS and Android. Pick a torrent and stream or download it on all your devices, with support for magnet links, .torrent files and pairing with a self-hosted bridge.

documents.name: Thunder
documents.subtitle: Lemmy & PieFed client
documents.description: Thunder is an open-source, cross-platform Lemmy and PieFed client for iOS and Android built with Flutter. It supports multiple accounts, customizable feeds and gesture-based navigation against any Lemmy or PieFed instance.

documents.name: Chan
documents.subtitle: 4chan imageboard browser
documents.description: Chan is a Flutter imageboard browser for iOS and Android. Browse 4chan threads and boards with media galleries, saved posts, pass login and a fast, native-feeling interface.

documents.name: Monal
documents.subtitle: XMPP instant messenger
documents.description: Monal is a free, open-source XMPP (Jabber) instant messenger for iOS and macOS. It offers OMEMO end-to-end encryption, multiple accounts, group chat and push notifications without a central server.

documents.name: JellyBook
documents.subtitle: Jellyfin e-book reader
documents.description: JellyBook is a nice way to read books and comics from Jellyfin. It streams EPUB, CBZ and PDF titles from your Jellyfin server to your iPhone or iPad with a clean reading interface.

documents.name: Hanami
documents.subtitle: Manga reader
documents.description: Hanami is an app for reading and saving manga on iOS and iPadOS. It works with self-hosted Komga and Kavita servers and supports offline downloads, library tracking and a fast native reader.

documents.name: Otraku
documents.subtitle: AniList client
documents.description: Otraku is an unofficial AniList client for Android and iOS built with Flutter. Browse, search and update your anime and manga lists with a polished native interface.

documents.name: PureKFD
documents.subtitle: Jailed package manager
documents.description: PureKFD is an exploit-based jailed package manager for iOS 15.0 through 18.x. It applies Misaka-style tweaks, themes and packages to compatible devices without a full jailbreak.

documents.name: Synkplay
documents.subtitle: Synced video playback
documents.description: Synkplay (Syncplay Mobile) is a Syncplay client for Android and iOS. Watch videos in sync with your friends — playback, pause and seeking are kept synchronized across everyone in the room.

documents.name: Ksign
documents.subtitle: ESign-style app signer
documents.description: Ksign is a community “cleaner” take on ESign — an iOS app signer and installer. Import IPA files, sign them with your own certificate and install them on device, with Feather-based app-icon styles.

documents.name: Cosmos Music Player
documents.subtitle: Music player
documents.description: Cosmos Music Player is a premium music player for iOS built on iCloud Drive and local storage. It gives you a clean, modern player for the music you keep on your device and in iCloud.

documents.name: AnimeGen
documents.subtitle: Anime art generator
documents.description: AnimeGen is a simple way to enjoy anime art. Generate anime-style images on your device using local AI models, with a gallery and save-to-photos workflow.

documents.name: MuffinStore
documents.subtitle: App Store downgrader
documents.description: MuffinStore is a TrollStore app for downgrading App Store apps. It lets you install older versions of apps from the App Store without a jailbreak, shipped as a TrollStore-named .tipa package.

documents.name: PlayTorrio
documents.subtitle: Streaming client
documents.description: PlayTorrio is a movies, TV and anime streaming client for iOS. It aggregates content into a browsable home-screen library with a native player.

documents.name: Mangayomi
documents.subtitle: Manga, novel & anime reader
documents.description: Mangayomi is a free, open-source app for reading manga and novels and watching anime, available on Android, iOS, macOS, Linux and Windows. It supports extensions for a wide range of sources.

documents.name: Nebulo
documents.subtitle: IPTV player
documents.description: Nebulo is a clean IPTV player for iOS with a built-in sports score center. Load your M3U playlists and watch live channels with a simple, focused interface.

documents.name: Chatsen
documents.subtitle: Twitch chat client
documents.description: Chatsen is a cross-platform Twitch chat application with third-party addon support. Follow chat in real time with support for BetterTTV, FrankerFaceZ and 7TV emotes and themes.

documents.name: TrollFools
documents.subtitle: Inject tweaks into installed apps on-device
documents.shortDescription: Inject tweaks into installed apps on-device
documents.description: TrollFools injects tweaks into apps that are already installed, straight on the device: it performs in-place dylib injection with insert_dylib and ChOma, so no computer and no jailbreak is involved. Upstream documents removable system applications, decrypted App Store apps installed through TrollStore, and encrypted App Store apps patched with a bare dynamic library, plus .deb and .zip tweak packages. Written in SwiftUI, and built on ChOma, MachOKit and insert_dylib.

documents.name: Lara
documents.subtitle: DarkSword customization toolbox for iOS 17 - 26.0.1
documents.description: lara is a jailed customization toolbox that uses the DarkSword exploit to reach the parts of the system iOS keeps locked: a full read/write file manager, a MobileGestalt editor, font / card / custom overwrites, status-bar tweaks, hidden icon labels, an upside-down mode, a five-icon dock, a grid app switcher, a performance HUD, DirtyZero 2, a three-app bypass and a JIT enabler for apps that carry get-task-allow. It is published as its own unsigned IPA for sideloading from the open-source repository.

documents.name: Onion Browser
documents.subtitle: Tor browser that routes web traffic through Tor
documents.shortDescription: Tor browser that routes web traffic through Tor
documents.description: Onion Browser is a free web browser for iPhone and iPad that encrypts and tunnels its traffic through the Tor network with the help of Orbot for iOS. The 3.x branch renders pages with WKWebView instead of the old UIWebView stack, and the project publishes its own sideloadable build next to the App Store release. Open source, with the repository's LICENSE file governing usage and redistribution.

documents.name: Orbot
documents.subtitle: Tor network tunnel for iOS and iPadOS
documents.shortDescription: Tor network tunnel for iOS and iPadOS
documents.description: Orbot puts an iPhone, iPad or Mac behind the Tor network: it installs a local packet-tunnel configuration so device traffic leaves through Tor instead of the plain network. Obfs4 and Snowflake bridges are supported and fully configurable, Tor v3 onion-service authentication works, and Tor's EntryNodes, ExitNodes, ExcludeNodes and StrictNodes options can all be set. The sideloadable build is published from the project's own GitHub releases, which list the bundled Tor, OpenSSL, Lyrebird and Snowflake versions per app release.

documents.name: Table Habit
documents.subtitle: Open-source micro-habit tracker with WebDAV sync
documents.shortDescription: Open-source micro-habit tracker with WebDAV sync
documents.description: Table Habit is a free, open-source habit tracker for building micro habits: a scoring system grades consistency rather than raw streaks, growth charts show the trend, and everything syncs across devices through any WebDAV endpoint - Nextcloud, Koofr or a self-hosted one. Offline-first, no ads, no in-app purchases and no account required, licensed under Apache-2.0. The iOS build OmniSource tracks is the project's own unsigned IPA from its GitHub releases, which AltStore, SideStore, Feather and ESign sign with your certificate at install time.

documents.name: ByeTunes
documents.subtitle: Add music to the iOS library without a computer
documents.shortDescription: Add music to the iOS library without a computer
documents.description: ByeTunes writes MP3, M4A, FLAC and WAV files straight into the iOS media library by talking to the media database directly, so adding a song no longer needs a cable and a desktop sync session. You can create and manage playlists in the app, and import metadata is fetched from iTunes or Deezer. The ringtone injector is disabled upstream for now, so treat ringtones as not working yet. Open source under the MIT license, with the iOS build published from the project's own GitHub releases.

documents.name: SNMessenger
documents.subtitle: Messenger tweak with its own sideloaded build
documents.shortDescription: Messenger tweak with its own sideloaded build
documents.description: SNMessenger is a full-featured tweak for Facebook Messenger by NguyenASang, published as a ready-to-sideload IPA built from the official tweak source. Its settings live behind the gear icon in the top-left corner of the Messenger profile screen, which is where every switch is flipped. Upstream documents rootless, rootful and sideload support (Roothide is listed as not supported), iOS 12.4 and newer, and Messenger versions from 458.0.0 up to the latest at release time. Open source under the MIT license.

documents.name: BHInstagram
documents.subtitle: Instagram with no ads, downloads and more tweaks
documents.shortDescription: Instagram with no ads, downloads and more tweaks
documents.description: BHInstagram is an open-source tweak for Instagram from the developer of BHTwitter, published as a ready-to-sideload IPA. It hides ads and suggested posts, asks for confirmation before likes, shows like counts, lets you copy captions and download videos, save profile pictures, keep deleted messages, and turn off last-seen, screenshot alerts and story view receipts.

documents.name: Reynard
documents.subtitle: Gecko-based browser, a real WebKit alternative
documents.shortDescription: Gecko-based browser, a real WebKit alternative
documents.description: Reynard is an experimental Gecko-based web browser for iOS 13 and up, rendering pages with the same engine Firefox uses instead of Safari's WebKit. It is actively developed and published from the project's own GitHub releases.

documents.name: Pocket Poster
documents.subtitle: Custom animated Poster Board wallpapers
documents.description: Pocket Poster creates custom, animated Poster Board wallpapers for iOS 17 to 26. Design your own live wallpapers with motion effects - no jailbreak needed.

documents.name: Mugunghwa
documents.subtitle: System-wide icon theming, no jailbreak
documents.description: Mugunghwa is a system-wide icon theming tool for iOS that works without a jailbreak. Change the icons of your apps system-wide, without the per-app icon replacement trick.

documents.name: WDBFontOverwrite
documents.subtitle: Install custom fonts on iOS 14-16.1.2
documents.description: WDBFontOverwrite overwrites the system font on iOS using CVE-2022-46689, letting you install custom fonts on iOS 14.0 to 16.1.2 without a jailbreak.

documents.name: Jaility
documents.subtitle: TrollStore supercharger and supervision
documents.description: Jaility is a simple iOS supercharger to be used with TrollStore. It keeps your device unlocked after a respring and adds supervision for extra control.

documents.name: KillMyOTA
documents.subtitle: Toggle OTA updates on iOS 15-16.1.2
documents.description: KillMyOTA enables or disables over-the-air iOS updates on jailbreak devices running iOS 15.0 to 16.1.2 - open the app and toggle updates on or off.

documents.name: TrollInstallerX
documents.subtitle: One-tap TrollStore installer
documents.description: TrollInstallerX installs TrollStore on compatible iOS devices - arm64 (iOS 14.0 - 16.6.1) and arm64e (iOS 14.0 - 16.5.1) - using the DirtyCow exploit.

documents.name: TrollBoard Reborn
documents.subtitle: Web Clips icon manager for TrollStore
documents.shortDescription: Web Clips icon manager for TrollStore
documents.description: TrollBoard Reborn is a WebClips icon pack manager - a theming engine for your home screen that runs with TrollStore on iOS 15 to 16.1.2.

documents.name: StatusMagic
documents.subtitle: Fully customizable status bar
documents.description: StatusMagic lets you fully customize the iOS status bar on iOS 14.0 to 16.1.2 without a jailbreak - change fonts, colors and elements to make the status bar yours.

documents.name: CarTube
documents.subtitle: YouTube on CarPlay
documents.description: CarTube turns your car's screen into a YouTube streaming hub through CarPlay, on devices running iOS 14.0 to 15.4.1.

documents.name: DynamicCow
documents.subtitle: Dynamic Island on iOS 16.0-16.1.2
documents.description: DynamicCow enables the Dynamic Island on every device running iOS 16.0 to 16.1.2 using the DirtyCow exploit.

documents.name: iTransmission
documents.subtitle: Fast, lightweight BitTorrent client
documents.description: iTransmission is a fast and lightweight BitTorrent client for iOS 13 and up. It downloads and manages torrents and magnet links directly on your iPhone or iPad.

documents.name: Cowabunga
documents.subtitle: MacDirtyCow customization toolbox
documents.description: Cowabunga is a toolbox for MacDirtyCow devices (iOS 14.0 - 15.7.1 and 16.0 - 16.1.2): a passcode editor, lock-screen footnotes, audio changer, SpringBoard tools and more - customization without a jailbreak.

documents.name: AirTroller
documents.subtitle: AirDrop spammer for TrollStore
documents.description: AirTroller is an AirDrop spammer/flooder to prank your friends, running on TrollStore and jailbroken iOS 14 and up.

documents.name: Helium
documents.subtitle: Status-bar widgets for TrollStore
documents.description: Helium adds status-bar widgets to TrollStore iPhones on iOS 14 and up - close the app and the HUD stays on your screen. It also works on jailbroken devices.

documents.name: SecondHand
documents.subtitle: Seconds in the status bar clock
documents.shortDescription: Seconds in the status bar clock
documents.description: SecondHand adds seconds to the status bar clock on TrollStore devices, with customizable date and time formats.

documents.name: CAPerfHUD
documents.subtitle: Quartz Debug-style performance HUD
documents.description: CAPerfHUD (Swift) is a Quartz Debug-style performance HUD for iOS - track FPS, CPU and GPU statistics on screen, as a TrollStore build.

documents.name: AppStore++
documents.subtitle: App Store manager for TrollStore
documents.description: AppStore++ enhances the App Store experience on TrollStore devices - downgrade and upgrade apps and manage your installed apps outside the official store.

documents.name: Nuvio
documents.subtitle: Open-source media player, bring your own sources
documents.shortDescription: Open-source media player, bring your own sources
documents.description: Nuvio is a free, open-source media app for your phone, desktop and the TV you already own. Bring your own sources - Nuvio turns them into a library with artwork, ratings, subtitles and your place saved on every screen.

documents.name: EscapeOS
documents.subtitle: App-data browser and backup for sideloaded apps
documents.shortDescription: App-data browser and backup for sideloaded apps
documents.description: EscapeOS is an on-device file browser and app-data backup/restore tool for sideloaded iOS, using a path-scoped container sandbox escape. No jailbreak, no Keychain. Browse an app's Documents, Library and tmp folders, edit or compress files, back up to an archive with a SHA-256 manifest, or reclaim cache space.

documents.subtitle: App-data browser, patch manager and wallpaper lab
documents.shortDescription: App-data browser, patch manager and wallpaper lab
documents.description: 3105 is a native iOS app-data browser, portable patch manager, limited cleaner and Poster Board wallpaper lab. It intentionally ships under the com.apple.mobile.MobileHouseArrest bundle identifier - the upstream documents that changing it breaks the MHA-C2 app-container workflow.

documents.name: VibeContainers
documents.subtitle: Jailbreak app runner, a LiveContainer fork
documents.shortDescription: Jailbreak app runner, a LiveContainer fork
documents.description: VibeContainers is a fork of Live Containers that runs jailbroken and tweaked apps on a non-jailbroken iOS 17 or newer device using the LiveContainer JIT. The published release is unsigned - sign it with a tool like AltStore or SideStore before installing.

documents.name: Battman
documents.subtitle: Battery health and charge management
documents.description: Battman is a battery manager for TrollStore and jailbroken iOS devices - battery health, cycle count and temperature, charging limits and a live gas gauge, with a plugin SDK for extra cards.

documents.name: Cercube for YouTube
documents.subtitle: Offline, PiP, background play and no ads for YouTube
documents.shortDescription: Offline, PiP, background play and no ads for YouTube
documents.description: Cercube for YouTube is the official YouTube enhancement from the original Cercube developer, relaunched in 2026: cache media for offline playback, use Picture in Picture and background playback, block supported video, feed and Shorts ads, choose default playback quality separately for Wi-Fi and cellular, reorder or hide tabs, auto-replay, skip sponsored segments, show dislike counts, queue videos - in 14 languages. It hooks the App Store YouTube app. Official distribution: apt.cercube.com (rootful, rootless and roothide jailbreak) and the altstore.cercube.com sideload source for AltStore (Classic), SideStore, Feather, eSign and friends.

documents.name: Nicegram
documents.subtitle: Independent Telegram client: multi-account, AI, privacy
documents.shortDescription: Independent Telegram client: multi-account, AI, privacy
documents.description: Nicegram is an independent, open-source messaging client built on the Telegram API (not affiliated with Telegram): manage unlimited accounts on one device, hidden accounts and chats (Double Bottom), built-in AI assistant and in-chat translation, voice-call recording in Saved Messages, quick replies and templates, pre-recorded video messages, a non-custodial Web3 wallet and escrow tools. Official distribution: App Store, TestFlight, and unsigned GitHub-release IPAs signed per the official install guide; this entry tracks the official nicegram/Nicegram-iOS release builds.

documents.name: Battery Info
documents.subtitle: Battery health, cycles and charge telemetry
documents.shortDescription: Battery health, cycles and charge telemetry
documents.description: Battery Info is a TrollStore utility from DevelopCubeLab: live charge voltage and current, full capacity, cycle count, temperature and a persistent charging-history database (QMax and limit voltage per charge). The developer also distributes it through the Havoc sideload store (havoc.app/package/batteryinfo).

documents.name: EnableQUIC
documents.subtitle: Enable QUIC for faster, more resilient networking
documents.shortDescription: Enable QUIC for faster, more resilient networking
documents.description: EnableQUIC is a TrollStore utility from DevelopCubeLab that switches the network stack onto QUIC where supported, with per-app enable/disable, restore-default-settings (including from backup), configuration-file locking and advanced settings.

documents.name: Animation Speed
documents.subtitle: System-wide UI animation speed control
documents.description: Animation Speed is a TrollStore utility from DevelopCubeLab that changes the global UI animation speed with a dial (speed range 0-10), with English localization.
